notes.title: Creator Mode, Leaderboards, Bugfix Update!
notes.content:
Hello Town Planners!

Now that Creator Mode and Leaderboards have been out for a couple of weeks, I've ironed out the bugs and they are both ready for public consumption!

The game has generally had a few fixes here and there, and it's in good shape to create your own levels, upload them, and share them with the world now. And every Custom Level will automatically get its own Leaderboard - so you can track who plays it and chooses to upload their score.

I look forward to seeing any and all creations you make in Going Loco!

David

notes.title: Leaderboards Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow Town Planners!

I've just dropped a cross-platform Leaderboard update. Now players on both Steam and Quest can compete for the best scores!

It's opt-in, so you'll be asked if you want to upload scores the next time you finish a level. If you change your mind later, you can find the setting in the Options Menu.

And, bonus: leaderboards will automatically work on any and all Custom Levels that are uploaded to mod.io, too! So you can set a challenge for your friends (and the world) and see who's the fastest!

David
